edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the privileged role is bound to an untrusted caller address
balances[msg.sender] is read/written in transfer and transferFrom using the caller-controlled address
allowed[msg.sender][...] is written in approve and approveAndCall using the caller-controlled address
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] by the user-supplied tokens amount via safeSub
transfer credits balances[to] with the user-supplied tokens amount via safeAdd
recipient argument of transfer is used as the key of the balances state write
approve writes the user-supplied tokens value into the allowed ledger
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the user-supplied spender
transferFrom debits balances[from] with a caller-supplied source address
transferFrom credits balances[to] with a caller-supplied recipient
transferFrom subtracts the user-supplied tokens from both balance and allowance via safeSub
transferFrom adds the user-supplied tokens to the recipient balance via safeAdd
the spender argument becomes the callee of the external receiveApproval call
the tokens argument is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call payload
arbitrary user-supplied data bytes are forwarded to the external callee
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract targeted by the external ERC20 transfer call
tokens amount is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into the pending-owner slot
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner] read through a caller-supplied address
constructor writes the fixed total supply and mints it to a hard-coded address

transfer invokes safeAdd to perform the overflow-checked credit
